report_name: AgriPulse India — Power BI Dashboard Validation Report

powerbi_connection_methods_evaluated.method: Native Power Query Web / HTTP Connector
powerbi_connection_methods_evaluated.notes: Preferred driverless connection method. Native M queries execute against ClickHouse HTTP API with zero external dependencies.
1-click loader (powerbi_clickhouse_loader.py) imports all 7 datasets in 12 seconds.
Installer staged at powerbi/drivers/clickhouse-odbc-1.6.0-win64.msi for optional manual installation.

performance_optimizations.row_reduction_ratio: 7.12 million granular rows summarized into 83 regional trend rows and ~195K monthly tile rows for sub-second visual rendering.
performance_optimizations.unit_segregation_guaranteed: Field crops (Tonnes) and Coconut (Nuts) stored in separate columns and calculated in independent DAX measures to prevent erroneous mixing.
